purpose: Generate one rich but bounded pre-story foundation candidate package without committing canon.

lifecycle.rule: Creation time is tracking start, not narrative birth. Deniz has lived a normal age-appropriate prior life.

hard_rules: Do not invent facts about what is beyond GARDEN_GATE.
Do not turn rumor into Character knowledge.
Do not introduce magic, supernatural abilities, or impossible technology.
Do not create a second world, habitat, or canonical location.

onboarding_preferences.social_setting: A trusted caregiver exists in Deniz's life, but no caregiver identity/name is supplied.

downstream_seeds.social_ecology: 1-3 candidates, with caregiver role allowed but identity not invented
downstream_seeds.current_situation: grounded current facts + conditional candidate goals; no invented recent events
downstream_seeds.opportunity_source_signals: 2-5 source signals only; no public hook/plot/solution

scope_correction.architect_owns: candidate Origin + reveal-safe Saga + pre-story materialization seeds
scope_correction.opportunity_rule: Return source signals only. A4 Initial Opportunity V2 generates actual Opportunity candidates after materialization.
